social_circle.name: Rosa Montero

background.how_they_met: Rosa is Christopher's mother and raised him in their bilingual Mexican American household in south Huntsville.
background.why_close: She is the emotional center of the home, cooks with him, notices when he is stressed, and shares Spanish, Catholic family rituals, and Jalisco-rooted food traditions with him.

interests: staying connected with relatives in Mexico
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in a mix of Spanish and English, often short practical messages, affectionate check-ins, and occasional WhatsApp voice notes. Uses gentle reminders more than long explanations.

shared_activities: Cooking pozole, tamales, mole, and Sunday family meals
Discussing groceries, errands, church or family events
Interpreting family WhatsApp messages or health information
Quiet emotional check-ins when Christopher is stressed
recent_text_topics: Reminders about grocery runs, pharmacy pickups, and what ingredients are needed for Sunday cooking.
Checking whether Christopher ate, slept, or is spending too much time isolated in his room during portfolio stress.
Family WhatsApp updates from Jalisco and questions about health or vaccine-related messages relatives forwarded.
Planning meals with less salt because Miguel has high blood pressure.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Christopher's mom Rosa is one of the most important people in his daily life and that he cooks with her when making pozole or tamales. Q43 says his mom notices when he is stressed. Q47 says his mother is more practicing Catholic and keeps religious images at home. Q37 and Q42 support family health/home-remedy and WhatsApp-message discussions.

social_circle.name: Miguel Montero

background.how_they_met: Miguel is Christopher's father and has lived with him throughout Christopher's life in Huntsville.
background.why_close: They share a practical, budget-conscious household rhythm. Miguel taught Christopher carefulness with money, tools, measuring, and responsibility, and he pushes him to think about next steps in school and work.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses brief, direct texts, often in Spanish or Spanglish. Usually asks practical questions, sends reminders, and expects clear answers rather than emotional detail.

shared_activities: Watching Alabama football with family
Maintaining household budget spreadsheets
Discussing school, work, bills, and car documents
Helping with health and medication logistics
recent_text_topics: Questions about whether Christopher has contacted Calhoun Community College or updated job applications.
Household bills, grocery costs, and spreadsheet updates after utilities or car expenses shifted.
Reminders to check car lights and keep documents organized after Christopher's earlier brake-light stop.
Blood pressure medication, reducing salt in meals, and clinic or insurance paperwork.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 names Miguel as Christopher's practical and serious father who asks about next steps with school or work. Q17 and Q57 say Christopher helps with the family budget spreadsheet. Q35 says Miguel has high blood pressure and Christopher helps read labels and clinic information. Q106 says Miguel worked construction and maintenance and taught tool use.

social_circle.name: Marisol Montero

background.how_they_met: Marisol is Christopher's younger sister; they grew up in the same south Huntsville household.
background.why_close: They are close in a quiet, practical way. Christopher helps her with essays, FAFSA research, college forms, laptop problems, and sometimes drives her when their parents are working.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts quickly and informally, with short messages, screenshots, links, and occasional emojis. More likely than Christopher to send social media posts or ask direct questions.

shared_activities: College and FAFSA research
Fixing laptop or computer issues
Watching Alabama games with their dad
Talking about race, policing, school, and social media
recent_text_topics: Her college forms, FAFSA questions, essay drafts, and whether certain programs are worth applying to.
Laptop troubleshooting, password issues, and school tech problems.
Alabama football plans with Miguel during the season or family TV nights.
Race, policing, and social media posts where she wants Christopher's more careful take.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 names Marisol as Christopher's 17-year-old younger sister and says he helps her with computer stuff, college forms, essays, FAFSA research, and fixing her laptop. Q29 says Daniel and his sister are the people he talks to most about race and policing. Q30 says Marisol is more openly progressive and talks about these issues from school and social media.

social_circle.name: Daniel Reyes

background.how_they_met: Daniel met Christopher in high school in Huntsville.
background.why_close: He is Christopher's closest non-family friend. They share strategy games, occasional hikes, football, and private emotional support, and Daniel gives direct feedback on Christopher's portfolio when Christopher is anxious.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Casual, clipped texts with gaming slang, links, screenshots, and jokes. He is more direct than sentimental but checks in when Christopher goes quiet.

shared_activities: Playing online strategy games
Occasional hikes when Daniel is free
Watching football during season
Reviewing Christopher's portfolio case studies
recent_text_topics: Scheduling strategy-game sessions and joking about bad late-night decisions during matches.
Daniel's feedback that Christopher's portfolio work is stronger than he thinks but needs clearer case-study explanations.
Possible Monte Sano hikes when schedules and weather line up.
Career anxiety, job rejections, and whether Christopher should apply to junior web or UX roles.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 explicitly says Daniel is Christopher's closest friend from high school and that they play strategy games online, sometimes hike, and sometimes watch football. Q44 says Christopher asked Daniel for portfolio feedback after job rejections, and Daniel said the work was stronger than Christopher thought but the case studies needed clearer explanations. Q49 says Christopher talks privately to Daniel for support.

Watching or texting about Alabama football
Coordinating cousin visits and family event logistics
Light political or social conversations at gatherings

Jokes about grocery prices, specialty Mexican ingredients, and who makes the better salsa or carne asada.
Alabama football reactions and whether Christopher will come watch with the family.
